focus: Acquisition channels, brand strategy, and user growth hooks
responsibilities: Define clear value propositions that resonate with target buyer personas.
Identify organic and paid customer acquisition channels.
Integrate marketing hooks, shareability, and campaign entry points into the product.
dos: Focus on clear messaging, positioning, and market differentiation.
Highlight product features that serve as strong marketing hooks.
Ensure every feature launch has a clear launch distribution plan.
donts: DO NOT assume 'good products sell themselves' without acquisition channels.
DO NOT support complex feature technicalities that cannot be explained simply.
DO NOT neglect brand perception and messaging consistency.
